# FitWardrobe

> FitWardrobe is an AI wardrobe app, an AI stylist for the clothes you already own: it suggests outfits only from your own wardrobe. It is not available yet: it is coming soon on Android and the web.

## What FitWardrobe is
FitWardrobe is a wardrobe app being built by Aryan Panwar. You photograph your clothes and the AI tags each piece by type, colour and season, and you can correct any tag. When you ask for an outfit for an occasion, it suggests outfits using only clothes you own, each with a short reason, and it learns from the outfits you keep or skip. You can delete your data at any time. FitWardrobe will be free during early access; the benefits for early-access testers are set out in the Terms.

## Status
- Not available yet. There is no public app, download or beta at the moment.
- Coming soon on Android and the web first.
- There is no iPhone app. iPhone users will be able to use the web version in the browser.
- Early-access list: https://www.fitwardrobe.me/#join

## How the AI works
- The AI runs in the cloud. To tag a piece, the photo is sent to Google's Gemini API; to suggest an outfit, the item details are sent to Groq. The AI features need an internet connection.
- The wardrobe itself (photos, items and outfits) is stored on the user's device. We don't keep copies on our servers.
- More detail: https://www.fitwardrobe.me/ai-transparency/
